scripts.lint:check: composer -d ../.. install && php ../../vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --memory-limit=1G --level=9 -v src tests
scripts.openapi: node -e "for (const d of ['lib', 'docs', '.openapi-generator']) require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })" && pnpm exec openapi-generator-cli generate -i ../../agdb_server/openapi.json -g php -o ./ -c openapi_generator.json && composer -d ../.. dump-autoload -o
scripts.test: composer -d ../.. install && node ../../agdb_server/test_server.mjs php -d xdebug.mode=coverage ../../vendor/bin/phpunit tests --coverage-filter src/ --coverage-text=coverage/coverage.txt --coverage-html coverage/ --coverage-cobertura coverage/coverage-final.xml && node coverage.js
